payload._note: This 10-K does not explicitly disclose Net Revenue Retention (NRR), Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), or specific top-customer concentration percentages. The filing emphasizes customer counts (total and large customers with ≥$1M subscription revenue), RPO/cRPO as forward-looking revenue indicators, and Fortune 100 penetration. No individual customer is disclosed as exceeding 10% of revenue. ARR growth is not explicitly stated as a standalone metric, though subscription revenue grew from $577.3M to $688.7M (approximately 19% YoY based on revenue recognition, though ARR may differ). Customer count metrics and RPO are the primary SaaS KPIs disclosed. The company operates in over 80 countries with customers including global enterprises, marketing agencies, government departments, and non-profits.
